There are a lot of survival books out there on how to bug-out, but this is the first-ever BUG-IN Guide. And the truth is, for almost every crisis out there, that’s what makes the most sense!

In this 240-page survival guide book, former Navy SEAL and BUD/S Instructor Joel Lambert will show you the emergency preparedness, survival tactics, and home security measures you need to turn your house into the safest place on Earth.

What You’ll Discover Inside:
✔Detailed step-by-step instructions along with high-resolution photos and illustrations make this survival book easy and practical to use.
✔Survival water purification methods to secure drinking water for you and your family.
✔The long-lasting emergency food supply you’ll need to outlast a long-term crisis.
✔Home defense strategies and a protection plan against looters and other intruders.
✔Self-sufficiency projects and survival methods to live in a world without electricity.
✔Survival skills for civilians directly from a SEAL Combat Veteran.
✔The first aid essentials you’ll need when Emergency Medical Services are no longer available.
✔Power outage preparedness and other life-saving tips that’ve been tested and proven.
✔A complete list of prepper must-haves, including survival gear and essential supplies.

Why would you ever want to leave your home if you have survival food storage, first aid essentials, and defensive home fortifications? Venturing outside puts your life at risk, and more than likely, supermarkets and pharmacies would have already run dry or been looted.

Much better to Bug-In! But you need a shelter-in-place guide to create your bug-in plan, or else you might overlook critical survival essentials that you just won’t be able to get once a crisis hits.

If you want to know what to do if martial law is declared, this bug-in book offers 7 strategic steps to help you adapt quickly, protect your family, and stay in control when normal freedoms and services are restricted.

A Navy SEAL’s Bug-In Guide will help you prepare for any kind of crisis, including severe scenarios like EMP events, social unrest, natural disasters, martial law, or a full-blown economic meltdown. Having this DIY survival book by your side may become one of the most valuable preparedness resources for your family.
